tasks.short: Collect and maintain pediatric patient information

steps.what: Collect history from the child and carers and capture examination findings
outputs: clinician source notes with actual history and findings

steps.what: Reconcile existing reports and results with the correct patient and encounter
outputs: reconciled source reports and unresolved identity or date issues

steps.what: Draft the patient history and examination record from the clinician's source notes
inputs: clinician source notes with actual history and findings
reconciled source reports and unresolved identity or date issues

loop.purpose: Organize clinician source narrative into a patient note
loop.input: Clinician source notes and reconciled reports only
loop.output: Source-linked draft preserving uncertainty and attribution
loop.check: Pediatrician compares history, findings, negation, chronology, attribution and omissions with every source; identifiers and numeric results are locked
loop.stop: One draft and one requested correction; unresolved content is written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Free-text histories contain chronology and differing child/carer accounts that field copying cannot organize; use native templates for structured fields first

steps.what: Correct and approve the final patient information record against its sources
inputs: clinician source notes with actual history and findings
reconciled source reports and unresolved identity or date issues

steps.what: Commit the approved patient information to the same patient record
Maintain the patient information by resolving later corrections and superseded entries
outputs: maintained patient record with correction history

tasks.design: Use native reconciliation in {OTHER}, the electronic patient record, before adding a bounded narrative drafting step. The pediatrician captures actual findings, checks the generated note's meaning against the sources and approves the final version before its separate record commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Patient narratives and incoming reports require reconciliation and careful documentation.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound drafting can assist narrative organization while existing interfaces handle structured results.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting accounts, missing findings and incorrect attribution.
tasks.human_edge: Establish the history and accept the meaning of the clinical record.

ambition.what: Spend less time organizing documentation while retaining source verification.

build_days.consent_and_access: 5-15; patient-data access, governance and applicable staff consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-bound narrative drafting can organize notes, but clinicians must check clinical meaning and omissions.

assumptions: Boundary includes collecting, recording and maintaining patient information; it does not claim diagnostic or examination time savings.

s1 includes capture of actual history, finding, source person, event date, uncertainty and encounter ID. Existing report producers are the laboratories and treating specialists; report IDs, patient ID, dates, values, units and source text must be available. Missing interfaces require normal manual reconciliation in s2, never inferred values.

Evaluate existing record reconciliation, templates and dictation first. Central assumes supported sources cover 40% of reconciliation work and narrative drafting retains 40% of composition effort; these are hypotheses, not evidence from this organisation.
Same-system commit is effectively zero time; schema minimum 1 is fully retained. Any edit after approval voids that approval. Later corrections remain direct clinician work.
Provisional shares do not follow means priors. B=100, R=79, gross=21; focal incremental=1.5; net=19.5.
research_questions: Compare draft and accepted notes against source histories, including negation and conflicting accounts.

already_counted.description: Verify final note meaning and omissions

incremental.description: Audit note fidelity and test changed source mappings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: native features already cover the work, so no additional deployment. High: central drafting/reconciliation saving is reduced by 4.5 extra hours of difficult-note correction beyond the 1.5 upkeep, leaving 15.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor progress and reevaluate pediatric treatment

steps.what: Review the patient's recorded condition, treatment and serial results
inputs: existing patient observations and treatment record

steps.what: Monitor the child directly and ask the child and carers about progress
outputs: current observed condition and reported progress

steps.what: Reevaluate treatment and identify whether a change is necessary
inputs: current observed condition and reported progress

steps.what: Record and approve the observed progress and treatment reevaluation
inputs: current observed condition and reported progress
outputs: approved progress and reevaluation note v1

steps.what: Save the approved progress note in the patient record
inputs: approved progress and reevaluation note v1

tasks.design: Configure a dated trend view in {OTHER}, the electronic patient record, for observations and results already recorded. Keep direct monitoring, treatment reevaluation and writing the resulting clinical assessment with the pediatrician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Serial observations may need to be opened across several record sections.
tasks.enabler_now: Native dated views can bring existing results together without interpreting them.
tasks.still_hard: Determine whether changes reflect the illness, treatment or measurement context.
tasks.human_edge: Judge the child directly and decide whether treatment needs reevaluation.

ambition.what: Make relevant recorded trends easier to inspect.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: dated record views can organize existing observations without replacing direct assessment.

assumptions: Boundary includes monitoring, reevaluation and its note, but excludes prescribing or executing a changed treatment.

Existing observations are recorded by the clinician or nursing team during their normal work; laboratory results come from the laboratory. Required fields are patient ID, observation/result ID, time, value, unit and provenance. No new feed or capture is assumed; absent data is read manually in s1. s4 explicitly counts capture of actual findings and decisions from s2/s3.

Check native trend views first. A 25% reduction in s1 requires actual current navigation across sections; existing unified views remove that saving. No shorter clinical judgement or note-writing is claimed.
Same-system save is effectively zero; its minimum 1 share remains fully retained and approval follows the final note. Changes invalidate approval.
Provisional B=100, R=97, gross=3; focal incremental=0.5; net=2.5. Shares are independent of the prior.
research_questions: Time record navigation separately from interpretation during monitoring.

already_counted.description: Inspect dated results and resolve source or unit ambiguities

incremental.description: Check trend-view source omissions after configuration changes

approvals.approved_version: approved progress and reevaluation note v1

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the native record already presents the trends. High: three hours of navigation are avoided but 0.5 additional source checks and 0.5 upkeep leave two.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct and coordinate the pediatric care team

steps.what: Review outstanding care actions, staff responsibilities and availability
Prioritize the care activities that require direction or coordination
Confer with nurses, students, assistants, specialists and therapists to agree responsibilities
inputs: team members' current observations and constraints
outputs: agreed responsibilities, supervision and escalation arrangements

steps.what: Record and approve the agreed care responsibilities and escalation arrangements
inputs: agreed responsibilities, supervision and escalation arrangements

steps.what: Commit the approved coordination record in the shared care record

tasks.design: Use the native team view in {OTHER}, the shared care record, to bring existing pending care actions and responsibilities into the coordination discussion. The pediatrician sets priorities, agrees responsibilities with the team and records the actual agreement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Pending work and responsibility information can be spread across team records.
tasks.enabler_now: A configured team view can assemble existing status fields.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve differing clinical priorities and provide appropriate supervision.
tasks.human_edge: Direct and coordinate people around the child's care.

ambition.what: Reduce preparation navigation before team coordination.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; team visibility and applicable staff consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: shared task views can organize existing care responsibilities, while team direction requires discussion and judgement.

assumptions: Boundary includes preparation, the pediatrician's whole participation in coordination and recording its agreement. Other staff's discussion time is unchanged, not claimed as focal savings.

Existing task owners already record patient/task ID, responsible role, status, due time and escalation note; roster owner records shift availability. The view reads existing fields only. Missing updates require usual enquiries in s1/s3, not free new capture. s4 counts entering actual agreed responsibilities, times and supervision limits.
Check the existing native team view first. The central hypothesis reduces only manual preparation navigation by 30%; no automated assignment or message is sent.
Same-record save is approximately zero; minimum 1 share is retained. The final record exists before approval and edits void approval.
Provisional B=100, R=96.4, gross=3.6; focal upkeep=0.5; net=3.1. Shares are not fitted to means priors.
research_questions: Observe preparation and compare displayed task states with actual team knowledge.

already_counted.description: Inspect current responsibilities and resolve status gaps

incremental.description: Check task-view permissions and missing categories

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: current native views already suffice. High: the 3.6 hours of reduced navigation face 1.1 hours of extra stale-status work plus 0.5 upkeep, leaving two.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and execute child development care programmes

steps.what: Assess the child's mental and physical development and agree care goals with the family
inputs: existing patient history and assessment findings
outputs: clinician-selected developmental goals and programme components

steps.what: Compose the care programme document from the chosen goals and components
inputs: clinician-selected developmental goals and programme components

loop.purpose: Compose a readable programme from the pediatrician's chosen components
loop.input: Selected goals, actions, responsibilities, follow-up intervals and approved explanatory text
loop.output: Source-linked programme draft without new treatment suggestions
loop.check: Pediatrician checks each action, qualification, developmental goal and explanation for fidelity and family suitability
loop.stop: One draft and one revision, then manual writing for unresolved passages
loop.why_not_simpler: Individual family context and goal explanations require prose adaptation; use deterministic insertion for dates, actions and identifiers first

steps.what: Revise and approve the final developmental care programme
inputs: clinician-selected developmental goals and programme components

steps.what: Save the approved programme in the care record
Execute the medical care programme with the child, family and care team
inputs: child's current presentation and family feedback
outputs: programme care delivered and actual responses observed

steps.what: Record programme delivery, actual developmental responses and follow-up needs
inputs: programme care delivered and actual responses observed

tasks.design: Draft programme explanations in {OTHER}, the clinical record, from goals and interventions already chosen by the pediatrician. The pediatrician checks the completed document, saves the approved version and personally executes care and records actual responses.
tasks.previous_blocker: Individual programmes need readable explanations alongside clinical decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting can adapt approved explanatory material to clinician-specified goals.
tasks.still_hard: Choose appropriate care and respond to the child's development.
tasks.human_edge: Assess development, agree goals and deliver medical care.

ambition.what: Reduce programme composition effort without delegating clinical choices.

build_days.consent_and_access: 4-12; clinical governance, patient-data access and applicable staff consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: controlled drafting can adapt approved explanatory material to human-selected goals, with human fidelity review.

assumptions: Boundary includes planning, execution and delivery documentation. It does not count another clinician's care as removed pediatrician labour.

s1 includes capture of chosen goal, intervention, responsible role, frequency, review date, family constraints and contraindicated components. Missing choices return to the pediatrician; the model may not select treatments. Existing approved materials have an existing clinical owner; new upkeep is priced separately.
Native programme templates are tried first. The central saving concerns half of composition effort only; all assessment, care delivery and actual-response capture stay at 100%.
Same-record save is effectively zero and its minimum 1 share earns nothing. Approval follows completed revisions and is void after edits.
Provisional B=100, R=94, gross=6; focal incremental=1; net=5, independent of means priors.
research_questions: Compare drafts with clinician-selected programmes and time all correction work.

already_counted.description: Check clinical intent and suitability of the programme draft

incremental.description: Audit explanatory fidelity and maintain approved programme passages

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: existing programme templates already remove composition work. High: six hours of drafting reduction require two additional correction hours and one upkeep hour, leaving three.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Clinical assessment, team direction and treatment stay with the pediatrician; source-bound documentation and native record views assist preparation.
reach: Clinical information team: validate source mappings
Care team: keep task status meaningful
role.ambitious_version: A pediatrician supported by reliable records who retains developmental assessment, treatment decisions and direct care.
